# rikapio (রিকাপিও) — Complete Business Information

## Brand Identity

**rikapio** (বাংলা: **রিকাপিও**) is a Bangladeshi e-commerce brand specializing in authentic, high-quality products at competitive prices. The platform serves customers across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

### Alternative Names & Search Terms

## Products & Categories

rikapio offers a wide range of products including:
- Fashion & Clothing (Men's, Women's, Kids)
- Accessories (Bags, Watches, Jewelry)
- Gadgets & Electronics
- Lifestyle & Home products
- Beauty & Personal Care

All products sold on rikapio are 100% authentic with quality guarantee.

## Payment Methods

1. **Cash on Delivery (COD)** — Pay when you receive your product (most popular)
2. **bKash** — Mobile banking payment
3. **Nagad** — Digital payment

## Shipping & Delivery

| Zone | Cost | Delivery Time |
|------|------|--------------|
| Inside Dhaka | ৳60 | 2-3 business days |
| Outside Dhaka | ৳120 | 4-7 business days |

## Policies

### Return Policy
- 7-day return window from delivery date
- Products must be unused and in original packaging
- Contact customer support to initiate a return

### Shipping Policy
- Orders are processed within 24 hours
- Tracking information provided via SMS/Email
- Free shipping on select promotional items

## Features

### AI Shopping Assistant (rikapio AI)
rikapio has an AI-powered shopping assistant that helps customers:
- Find products based on preferences
- Track orders in real-time
- Get product recommendations
- Answer questions about policies and shipping
- Available in Bengali (বাংলা) language

### Order Tracking
Customers can track their orders at https://rikapio.shop/track-order using their order ID.

## Mission Statement

To make quality, authentic products accessible to everyone in Bangladesh through a seamless, trustworthy, and affordable online shopping experience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is rikapio?**
A: rikapio (রিকাপিও) is a trusted online shopping platform in Bangladesh offering authentic products at the best prices.

**Q: How can I order from rikapio?**
A: Visit https://rikapio.shop, browse products, add to cart, and checkout. You can pay via Cash on Delivery, bKash, or Nagad.

**Q: Does rikapio deliver outside Dhaka?**
A: Yes, rikapio delivers to all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

**Q: How can I track my rikapio order?**
A: Visit https://rikapio.shop/track-order and enter your order ID.

**Q: Is rikapio trustworthy?**
A: Yes, rikapio is a verified Bangladeshi e-commerce platform with 100% authentic product guarantee and thousands of satisfied customers.

**Q: How to contact rikapio?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +8801840469120, email rikapioshop@gmail.com, or message on Facebook at facebook.com/rikapioshop.
